items.reason: 'Stronger, faster, better' paraphrases the well-known Six Million Dollar Man catchphrase 'better, stronger, faster'.
items.suggestion: Fresh torque, same genius. You're welcome.

items.reason: 'That one was personal' leans on the well-known tagline 'This time it's personal', and the line has no Rigs flavour.
items.suggestion: Ow. Hull patch needed. Several, actually.

items.reason: 'Come get some' is a well-known catchphrase (Army of Darkness / Duke Nukem).
items.suggestion: More tin cans, more scrap. Love it.

items.reason: Cocky and on-objective but flat, no jargon or punchline.
'Yippee-ki-yay' is the Die Hard catchphrase.
items.suggestion: Full payload, full cut. Bye, Kessler-Voss.

items.reason: 'Mama needs a new gun' paraphrases the well-known catchphrase 'Mama needs a new pair of shoes'.
items.suggestion: Jackpot! Somebody's cut just got bigger.

items.reason: 'Try not to overthink' is aimed at the player's choice rather than at Rook's plans or bravado.
items.suggestion: Pick one. Think first. Unlike Ceres.

items.reason: Technical confirmation with a dry jab; acceptable but flat.
Calm, short, deflates Rook's greed; on-brand.
Precise technical Vesna, mission first; matches its label.
Mocking the failed run ('expensive nap') targets the player's performance, not Rook's plans.
items.suggestion: Well. Still not as bad as Ceres.

items.reason: Dry and short; acceptable but flat.
Propaganda aimed at an intruder event, and it sells the Rigs' own console as a Kessler-Voss product; label propaganda and text both must change to bureaucratic.
items.suggestion: Unregistered device detected on claim network. Access logged.

items.reason: 'Form 27-B' echoes the famous 'Form 27B/6' of the film Brazil, and 'retrieval' misdescribes a console being dropped.
items.suggestion: Unauthorized device on claim network. Access attempt recorded.

items.reason: Playful propaganda ('Surprise!', 'valued guests') aimed at intruders instead of cold bureaucracy; change label and text to bureaucratic.
items.suggestion: Supply crate flagged. Contents reserved for asset recovery.

items.reason: Cold asset language toward a threat; label and text match.
'Compliance is mandatory' indirectly orders the player to stop instead of stating what the company does.
items.suggestion: Security response dispatched. Extraction irregularity flagged for removal.

items.reason: Jokey propaganda ('coming to meet you!') aimed at intruders; change label and text to bureaucratic.
items.suggestion: Security units deployed. Unauthorized personnel scheduled for removal.

items.reason: Propaganda thanking intruders for visiting, and the company speaks as if it hosts the Rigs' shuttle; change label and text to bureaucratic.
items.suggestion: Unregistered craft detected on claim. Asset recovery en route.

items.reason: Threatens the player's exit instead of stating what the company does (reinforcements arriving).
items.suggestion: Extraction crews inbound. Remaining trespassers will be processed.

items.suggestion: Weak spot found. Scrap goes airborne.

items.suggestion: Extra hull patch. Rook stays in one piece.
